Title: General availability: Azure Kubernetes Service in UK West

Body.Content:
Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) is now generally available in the UK West region, bringing the number of regions for the service to 14.

With AKS now GA in both of the UK's Azure regions, you can maximize the availability of your applications and ensure a strong disaster recovery strategy within the UK border.
